headline: Approved June 23 minutes; discussed hot-weather cooling sites, Master Plan housing input, and cut bus lines.
summary: Members gave updates on training, a hot-weather plan, and housing work. They discussed how the group could take part in the Master Plan process and reviewed a governance survey. The only recorded decision was approving the June 23 minutes.
